verses.original: Περὶ δὲ τῶν εἰδωλοθύτων οἴδαμεν ὅτι πάντες γνῶσιν ἔχομεν ἡ γνῶσις φυσιοῖ ἡ δὲ ἀγάπη οἰκοδομεῖ
verses.transliteration: Peri de tōn eidōlothytōn oidamen hoti pantes gnōsin echomen hē gnōsis physioi hē de agapē oikodomei
verses.literal: Now about food sacrificed to idols We know that we all have knowledge Knowledge puffs up but love builds up

verses.original: εἴ τις δοκεῖ ἐγνωκέναι τι οὔπω ἔγνω καθὼς δεῖ γνῶναι
verses.transliteration: ei tis dokei egnōkenai ti oupō egnō kathōs dei gnōnai
verses.literal: The one who thinks he knows something does not yet know as he ought to know

verses.original: εἰ δέ τις ἀγαπᾷ τὸν Θεόν οὗτος ἔγνωσται ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ei de tis agapa ton Theon houtos egnōstai hyp’ autou
verses.literal: But the one who loves God is known by God

verses.original: Περὶ τῆς βρώσεως οὖν τῶν εἰδωλοθύτων οἴδαμεν ὅτι οὐδὲν εἴδωλον ἐν κόσμῳ καὶ ὅτι οὐδεὶς Θεὸς εἰ μὴ εἷς
verses.transliteration: Peri tēs brōseōs oun tōn eidōlothytōn oidamen hoti ouden eidōlon en kosmō kai hoti oudeis Theos ei mē heis
verses.literal: So about eating food sacrificed to idols We know that an idol is nothing at all in the world and that there is no God but . . . one

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ εἴπερ εἰσὶν λεγόμενοι θεοὶ εἴτε ἐν οὐρανῷ εἴτε ἐπὶ γῆς ὥσπερ εἰσὶν θεοὶ πολλοὶ καὶ κύριοι πολλοί
verses.transliteration: kai gar eiper eisin legomenoi theoi eite en ouranō eite epi gēs hōsper eisin theoi polloi kai kyrioi polloi
verses.literal: For even if there are so-called gods whether in heaven or on earth (as there are many so-called gods and lords

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ἡμῖν εἷς Θεὸς ὁ Πατήρ ἐξ οὗ τὰ πάντα καὶ ἡμεῖς εἰς αὐτόν καὶ εἷς Κύριος Ἰησοῦς Χριστός δι’ οὗ τὰ πάντα καὶ ἡμεῖς δι’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: all’ hēmin heis Theos ho Patēr ex hou ta panta kai hēmeis eis auton kai heis Kyrios Iēsous Christos di’ hou ta panta kai hēmeis di’ autou
verses.literal: yet for us there is but one God the Father from whom all things came and for whom we exist And there is but one Lord Jesus Christ through whom all things came and through whom we exist

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐν πᾶσιν ἡ γνῶσις τινὲς δὲ τῇ συνηθείᾳ ἕως ἄρτι τοῦ εἰδώλου ὡς εἰδωλόθυτον ἐσθίουσιν καὶ ἡ συνείδησις αὐτῶν ἀσθενὴς οὖσα μολύνεται
verses.transliteration: All’ ouk en pasin hē gnōsis tines de tē synētheia heōs arti tou eidōlou hōs eidōlothyton esthiousin kai hē syneidēsis autōn asthenēs ousa molynetai
verses.literal: But not everyone has this knowledge Some people are still so accustomed . . . . . . to idols that they eat such food as if it were sacrificed to an idol And since their conscience is weak it is defiled

verses.original: βρῶμα δὲ ἡμᾶς οὐ παραστήσει τῷ Θεῷ οὔτε ἐὰν μὴ φάγωμεν ὑστερούμεθα οὔτε ἐὰν μὴ φάγωμεν περισσεύομεν
verses.transliteration: brōma de hēmas ou parastēsei tō Theō oute ean mē phagōmen hysteroumetha oute ean mē phagōmen perisseuomen
verses.literal: But food does not bring us closer . . . to God We are no worse if we do not eat and no better if we do

verses.original: Βλέπετε δὲ μή πως ἡ ἐξουσία ὑμῶν αὕτη πρόσκομμα γένηται τοῖς ἀσθενέσιν
verses.transliteration: Blepete de mē pōs hē exousia hymōn hautē proskomma genētai tois asthenesin
verses.literal: Be careful however that your freedom does not become a stumbling block to the weak

verses.original: ἐὰν γάρ τις ἴδῃ σὲ τὸν ἔχοντα γνῶσιν ἐν εἰδωλείῳ κατακείμενον οὐχὶ ἡ συνείδησις αὐτοῦ ἀσθενοῦς ὄντος οἰκοδομηθήσεται εἰς τὸ τὰ εἰδωλόθυτα ἐσθίειν
verses.transliteration: ean gar tis idē se ton echonta gnōsin en eidōleiō katakeimenon ouchi hē syneidēsis autou asthenous ontos oikodomēthēsetai eis to ta eidōlothyta esthiein
verses.literal: For if someone with a weak conscience sees you who are well informed eating in an idol’s temple will he not be encouraged to eat food sacrificed to idols

verses.original: ἀπόλλυται γὰρ ὁ ἀσθενῶν ἐν τῇ σῇ γνώσει ὁ ἀδελφὸς δι’ ὃν Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν
verses.transliteration: apollytai gar ho asthenōn en tē sē gnōsei ho adelphos di’ hon Christos apethanen
verses.literal: So this weak brother for whom Christ died is destroyed by your knowledge

verses.original: οὕτως δὲ ἁμαρτάνοντες εἰς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ τύπτοντες αὐτῶν τὴν συνείδησιν ἀσθενοῦσαν εἰς Χριστὸν ἁμαρτάνετε
verses.transliteration: houtōs de hamartanontes eis tous adelphous kai typtontes autōn tēn syneidēsin asthenousan eis Christon hamartanete
verses.literal: By sinning against your brothers in this way and wounding their weak conscience you sin against Christ

verses.original: Διόπερ εἰ βρῶμα σκανδαλίζει τὸν ἀδελφόν μου οὐ μὴ φάγω κρέα εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἵνα μὴ τὸν ἀδελφόν μου σκανδαλίσω
verses.transliteration: Dioper ei brōma skandalizei ton adelphon mou ou mē phagō krea eis ton aiōna hina mē ton adelphon mou skandalisō
verses.literal: Therefore if what I eat causes my brother to stumble I will never eat meat again so that I will not cause him to stumble
